{{Top|leg}}
An '''ammonia chamber''' was an [[Airlock/Legends|airlocked]] room that could be filled with [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]. The [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] had an ammonia chamber in the intensive care unit of its [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]]. This chamber contained a bed and an [[Intercom/Legends|intercom]] that was mounted to the outside of the chamber's [[Glass/Legends|glass]] walls.<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agreed to treat [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], for injuries that he had sustained earlier in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This was in exchange for his services, when he had rescued over 90 wounded Rebels from the downed [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']] and delivered them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]]. Upon the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']]{{'s}} arrival to the Rebel [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]], Zuckuss was immediately taken to sick bay, where he was placed in an ammonia chamber. Inside that chamber, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] worked to regrow Zuckuss's [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-scarred tissue, which gave him functioning [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] within a few days of the surgery.<ref name="OPF" />
